# A2/A3 — The natural hold-out (Task 1.3)

*Generated by `analysis/a2_holdout_counts.py`; do not edit numbers by hand.*

**Claim.** Across 83 RTFP Bangladesh releases (2024-01-25 to 2026-10-05), 18,184 market-month-item cells were imputed in one release and observed in a later one. Only 5,768 of them are clean late arrivals usable for evaluation (forecast + cross-sectional strata); the rest are pipeline toggles, values that later vanished, or historical backfill.

**Cells by stratum** (precedence toggle > unconfirmed > backfill > forecast > cross_sectional):

| item | backfill | cross_sectional | forecast | toggle | unconfirmed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| lentils | 13 | 207 | 1405 | 2465 | 154 |
| oil | 9 | 211 | 1494 | 2966 | 244 |
| rice | 73 | 230 | 593 | 2746 | 318 |
| wheat_flour | 554 | 224 | 1404 | 2551 | 323 |

- *toggle*: the survey value was already in an earlier release, then dropped and restored. Not a late arrival.
- *unconfirmed*: the value that appeared is not in the latest release (and therefore not in the WFP feed, Table A1). Not usable as truth.
- *backfill*: arrived more than 6 months after the price month. Mostly wheat flour; consistent with the first release holding fewer pre-2023 wheat-flour survey values (2,084) than the most common count in later releases (2,548), though the cause is not documented.
- *forecast*: no market observed for that item-month in the imputing release (real-time nowcast: the imputing release came a median of 1 month(s) after the price month).
- *cross_sectional*: some markets observed that item-month in the imputing release.

**Monthly change pairs** (both published values from the same imputing release; truth from the latest release):

| item | stratum | both_imputed | imputed_t_observed_prev |
|---|---|---|---|
| lentils | backfill | 3 | 7 |
| lentils | cross_sectional | 87 | 83 |
| lentils | forecast | 271 | 1034 |
| lentils | toggle | 947 | 1406 |
| oil | backfill | 2 | 5 |
| oil | cross_sectional | 83 | 108 |
| oil | forecast | 302 | 1137 |
| oil | toggle | 982 | 1878 |
| rice | backfill | 27 | 45 |
| rice | cross_sectional | 75 | 126 |
| rice | forecast | 189 | 348 |
| rice | toggle | 874 | 1607 |
| wheat_flour | backfill | 501 | 30 |
| wheat_flour | cross_sectional | 117 | 70 |
| wheat_flour | forecast | 287 | 1048 |
| wheat_flour | toggle | 798 | 1673 |

**Clean strata cover only recent months:** price months 2023-09-01 to 2026-08-01. Cells never observed in any release are mostly 2007–2019 history (Table A3), so hold-out results describe recent imputations and do not transfer automatically to the historical record.

**Truth revisions:** share of confirmed cells whose first-observed value differs (>0.1%) from the latest value — Table A2d (0.0–3.4% by item and stratum).

**Backfill threshold sensitivity** (3 / 6 / 12 months): Table A2e. Cross-sectional cells per item: 159–193 (3 months), 207–230 (6), 213–303 (12).

**Method.** `src/rtfp/vintages.py`; invariants tested in `tests/test_vintages.py` (rules on toy data) and `tests/test_vintages_data.py` (re-checked by direct lookups on real data).

**Caveats.**
- The headline sample is small: both-imputed cross-sectional pairs number 75–117 per item. Confidence intervals will be wide; the forecast stratum is larger but answers a different question (real-time nowcasting).
- The 6-month backfill threshold is a judgement call made after looking at the arrival-lag distribution, recorded after that inspection in the draft (not yet posted) analysis plan with 3 and 12 months as robustness. It matters most for rice: its cross-sectional cells number 178 (3 months), 230 (6) and 303 (12); see Table A2e.
- Pipeline toggling between releases is documented here from the data; its cause is not known to us.

**Files.** `outputs/tables/T_A2_holdout_counts.csv`, `T_A2b_pair_counts.csv`, `T_A2c_stratum_timing.csv`, `T_A2d_truth_revisions.csv`, `T_A2e_backfill_threshold_sensitivity.csv`, `T_A3_covariate_balance.csv`.
